undated_mentions: Junior clerk at the City of Glasgow Bank
Worked for the Bank of Australasia, then Rae, Dickson & Co.
Worked for an estate agent, then as auctioneer and land agent
Built Toorak House, a villa overlooking the Brisbane River
Educated at the High School of Glasgow
Briefly Opposition Leader in the absence of Sir Samuel Griffith
Served as Chief Secretary under Robert Philp
